explication: This repository is a collection of small Go implementations, not one application. Its principal user-facing flows are HTTP requests through Gee, cache lookups through GeeCache, ORM operations against SQL databases, and RPC calls through GeeRPC. The README also documents WebAssembly demos; the tree contains Gee-Bolt examples as well. Most implementation detail is unsampled, so links between those subsystems are limited to documented capabilities or the shown cache example.
